title: Universal derived tensor tower from K-flat resolutions
statement: For a scheme X, a sheaf R of commutative rings in the coefficient universe, and any inverse sequence P of R-module sheaves, the whole ordinary tensor diagram K tensor P admits a universal left-derived functor on the standard derived category. Its natural counit is invertible for every independent-coefficient K-flat complex K. No triangulated structure is imposed on the target diagram category.

proof.text: Tensor descends through chain homotopies to the homotopy category. If f is a quasi-isomorphism between K-flat complexes, resolve its other tensor factor. Tensoring a quasi-isomorphism with a K-flat complex preserves quasi-isomorphisms by the mapping-cone criterion; the signed tensor flip gives the other variable. The natural square and two-of-three show that f tensor any factor is a quasi-isomorphism. Thus the entire quotient diagram inverts quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. Resolve every complex by a K-flat complex, and apply the resolving-class essential-constancy and pointwise Kan bridge. The identity resolution shows its counit is invertible on every K-flat complex. Precomposition by the full essentially surjective homotopy quotient preserves the defining Kan limits; transport along quotientCompQhIso gives the cochain universal property and the specified counit.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YT and 06YU; derived.tex 06XN. Explicit cone, resolving-class, and pointwise Kan proof.
